hints.title: Concurrent Numeric Promise Summation
hints.text: Awaiting two asynchronous promises simultaneously and adding their resolved numeric results produces a single summed promise.

hints.title: Promise Concurrency Aggregation
hints.text: Pass both promises into Promise.all to await them in parallel. Destructure the two numeric results and return their sum.

hints.title: Summation Blueprint
hints.text: const [v1, v2] = await Promise.all([promise1, promise2]); return v1 + v2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Parallel resolution runs in max(t1, t2) asynchronous time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Awaiting promise1 before starting promise2 serializes execution to t1 + t2.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Promise.all awaits concurrently in constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Parallel execution using Promise.all or destructuring.

solutions.approach: Parallel Promise Resolution with Destructured Addition
